impact:
CONFIRMED 2026-08-31 (supersedes the original "synthesis never fires" framing).

Synthesis DOES fire and succeed. A push at 16:28:03 that carried two genuinely new observations produced synthesis-status.json {"outcome":"ok","timestamp":"2026-08-31T16:29:07.624Z"} on the Fly volume, and rewrote PERSONA.md from 118 to 134 lines. The ISS-045/046/047 fixes are all working in production.

The original symptom is explained by the ticket's own leading hypothesis, now confirmed: the 15:56:26 push carried zero new rows (the client's pushSince cursor had already advanced past them on an earlier push), so `obsAdded > 0` was false and nothing was enqueued. No status file was written because synthesize() was correctly never called.

THE REAL DEFECT is the second-order consequence, which is worse than the reported one. handleSyncPush both GATES ON and FEEDS FROM the current push's delta (`payload.observations`), not from unsynthesized input:

  const meaningful = payload.observations.filter((o) => o.confidence !== "low");
  if (obsAdded > 0 && meaningful.length > 0) { ... observations: meaningful ... }

Because src/sync.ts push() advances `pushSince` past everything it sent, an observation is offered to synthesis EXACTLY ONCE. If that one synthesis attempt fails — which it did on every attempt for three months under the ISS-045 timeout — those observations are never retried and never reach PERSONA. The client cursor has moved on and no later push re-sends them.

MEASURED LOSS: 66 observations dated 2026-05-28 through 2026-08-31 were delivered to the server (they are in observations.jsonl) but are absent from PERSONA. The 16:29 synthesis only saw the 2 observations that the last push happened to carry, which is why PERSONA jumped straight from "### 2026-05-24" to "[Current Session]" and skipped three months of accumulated signal.

FIX: gate on and feed from a per-tenant synthesis high-water mark rather than a single push's delta. Persist lastSynthesizedAt, select all meaningful observations newer than it, advance the mark ONLY after a successful synthesis writes PERSONA. A failed synthesis then retries the same batch on the next push instead of dropping it.
title: Synthesis gated on push delta, not unsynthesized input — silently drops observations from PERSONA
